reasoning: PKGBUILD safely handles prebuilt binaries from trusted source with HTTPS and checksum verification. No dangerous code executes during source fetch or installation.
coverage_issues: Binary payload (.pkg.tar.zst) skipped entirely - contains actual executables/configs
No review of .install hooks or extracted files (e.g., chrome-sandbox permission changes)
false_negatives: Potential risks in binary payload (network/filesystem access in Chromium) not examined
Sandbox permission changes not verified for security implications
learnings: Prioritize review of .install scripts and extracted configs over skipped binaries
Improve handling of binary packages: warn about inherent trust requirements
Detect permission changes (setuid) as security-critical operations
Verify source URL trustworthiness beyond just HTTPS presence
